name: Identity Federation & SSO Security
description: Security assessment of identity federation and single sign-on deployments. Covers SAML 2.0 and OIDC/OAuth 2.0 flows, identity provider configuration (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, Ping Identity, AD FS), token issuance, validation, and lifetime, federation trust and signing-certificate management, token-forgery attack paths such as golden SAML, and multi-factor authentication and conditional access bypass. Entra ID tenant configuration is covered by INFRA-AZURE-ENTRAID and application-level authorisation flaws by SWSEC-WEB-AUTHZ.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to identity federation or SSO security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands federation and SSO protocols and their security properties
evidence: Can explain SAML 2.0 and OIDC/OAuth 2.0 roles, flows, and assertions/tokens
Understands the trust relationship between an identity provider and service providers
Familiar with common federation weaknesses (weak assertion validation, long token lifetimes, misconfigured trust)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews federation and SSO configurations under supervision
evidence: Reviewed SAML and OIDC application configurations against a checklist under guidance
Inspected tokens and assertions with tooling (SAML tracer, jwt decoders) with supervisor review
Documented signing-certificate, audience, and token-lifetime findings with supervision

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses federation deployments and identifies attack paths
evidence: Independently assessed SAML and OIDC/OAuth configurations across multiple identity providers
Identified assertion-validation, signature, and audience-restriction weaknesses that enable token forgery such as golden SAML
Evaluated MFA enrolment and conditional access policies for bypassable gaps
Produced federation assessment reports with prioritised remediation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-IdP federation assessments and mentors others
evidence: Assessed complex federation topologies spanning multiple IdPs, SaaS relying parties, and B2B trust
Traced end-to-end token-forgery and session-hijacking attack chains across federated systems
Developed tooling or detections for federation abuse (anomalous assertions, token replay)
Reviews federation assessment work of junior analysts

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines the lab's federation assessment methodology and is a recognised authority
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's identity federation and SSO assessment framework
Published research on federation protocol weaknesses or token-forgery techniques
Advises organisations on secure federation and conditional access architecture
Trains teams on advanced identity federation security assessment

assessment_methods.description: Assess a lab federation deployment with a misconfigured IdP and relying parties, identify assertion/token validation and conditional access weaknesses, and demonstrate their impact
Review federation and SSO assessment findings from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy
